decisions.reason: Having survived the first review and sitting very close to the core pump business, it likely performs at or near aspiration levels, so we keep it and continue incremental market learning.
As a product line with several models embedded in the established transfer-pump offering, it is likely meeting aspirations in enough customer niches that adaptation is preferable to withdrawal.

Although still the most uncertain and somewhat adjacent, its relevance for future-oriented, interoperable solutions and another year of market presence justify keeping it unless results fall clearly below aspirations.

Because this 2024 launch is close to the core offer but still has limited performance history, available organizational slack and problemistic search favor retaining it for another year while early results are assessed against aspirations.
